versions.changelog:
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify links, notably changing "Create an API key" to "Open the account dashboard."
- No changes to code, API surfaces, or functionality—documentation update only.
- All workflows, integration guidance, and security rules remain unchanged.

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to add a new "Start on APIDot" section for easier onboarding.
- Improved organization and clarity of entry points and workflow guidance in SKILL.md.
- Removed redundant or extra introductory sections; usage and model routing sections are now more concise.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Added an optional shell script (scripts/submit_veo_3_1.sh) for server-side Veo 3.1 task submission using curl and APIDot API key.
- Updated documentation to cover the new script, including security requirements and usage guidance.
- Removed skill-card.md to streamline package content.
- Clarified security rules for running scripts and handling sensitive data.
- No install-time automation or background jobs introduced; all automation is user-invoked and server-side only.

- Added references/api.md with local, non-executable notes for Veo 3.1 model routing and async workflow.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated SKILL.md to reflect the inclusion of reference notes, clarify usage of references/api.md, and adjust documentation coverage.
- No executable files or active API logic were added; skill remains documentation-focused.

- Initial release of the apidot-veo-3-1-api skill, focused on APIDot Veo 3.1 API workflows.
- Provides detailed integration guidance for text-to-video, image-to-video, reference video, async task handling, status polling, and webhook setup using APIDot docs.
- Includes comprehensive security best practices for handling APIDot API keys and sensitive data.
- Offers model-specific routing and directs users to official APIDot documentation, examples, and quickstart resources.
- Documentation-only release: no scripts, API clients, or executable files are included.
